<!-- PAGE 3: Extra Content -->

<!-- 
Set coordinates to frame the page
letter paper is 215.9 by 279.4 mm
1.1 blue header + margin
0.5 bottom margin
27.94 - 1.1 - 0.5 = 26.34
26.34 / 2 = 13.17

THIS PAGE SHOULD MATCH PAGE 2 IN BORDER

Extra Image dimensions:
Width = 21.59 - 0.5 - 0.5 (margins) = 20.59
Height = 13.17 - 0.85 = 12.32

Ratio: 20.59/12.32 = 1.671266 ~ 5:3
-->

\begin{tikzpicture}

  `r # Define coordinates`
  \coordinate[below right = 0.5cm and 0.5cm of current page.north west] (tl);
  \coordinate[below left = 0.5cm and 0.5cm of current page.north east] (tr);
  \coordinate[above left = 0.5cm and 0.5cm of current page.south east] (br);
  
  `r # Lines`
  \coordinate[below right = 1.1cm and 0.5cm of current page.north west] (line0l);
  \coordinate[below left = 1.1cm and 0.5cm of current page.north east] (line0r);
  \coordinate[below right = `r 1.1 + 12.32`cm and 0.5cm of current page.north west] (line1l);
  \coordinate[below left = `r 1.1 + 12.32`cm and 0.5cm of current page.north east] (line1r);
  
  \coordinate[below = 1.1cm of tl] (line0);
  \coordinate[below = `r 1.1 + 12.32`cm of tl] (line1);
  \coordinate[above = 1.1cm of br] (line2);
  
  % Draw borders
  \draw[blue, line width = 0.1cm] (tl) rectangle (br);
  `r if(nrow(f) == 2) "\\draw[blue, line width = 0.1cm] (line1l) -- (line1r);"`
  
  % Top blue bar with title
  \fill[blue] ([xshift = -0.05cm]tl) rectangle ([yshift = -0.6cm, xshift = 0.05cm]tr);
  \node[below = 0.6cm of current page.north, white, font = \large\bf] (num) {Supplementary Info \#`r ceiling(i/2)`};
  \node[below left = 0.65cm and 0.55cm of current page.north east, white, font = \bf] (num) {Aquifer \#`r f$aquifer_id[1]`};

  % Figures & Text
  
  % First figure
  \node[below right = 1cm and 0.2cm of line0l, anchor = north west] (f1) {\includegraphics[`r f$p3_image_position[1]`]{`r here(f$p3_loc[1])`}};
  
  % Text for first figure - besides if half page, below if full page
  
  `r if(f$p3_page[1] == 0.5 & !is.na(f$p3_txt[1])) paste0("\\node[below left = 1cm and 0.15cm of line0r, anchor = north east, align = left, text ", f$p3_text_position[1], ", font = \\small\\bf] {", f$p3_txt[1], "};")`
  
  `r if(f$p3_page[1] == 1 & !is.na(f$p3_txt[1])) paste0("\\node[below = 0.5cm of f1.south west, anchor = north west, align = left, text ", f$p3_text_position[1], ", font = \\small] {", f$p3_txt[1], "};")`
  
  `r # Second figure & text (if exists)`
  \node[below right = 1cm and 0.2cm of line1l, anchor = north west] {`r if(nrow(f) == 2) paste0("\\includegraphics[", f$p3_image_position[2], "]{", here(f$p3_loc[2]), "}")`};
  `r if(nrow(f) == 2) paste0("\\node[below left = 1cm and 0.15cm of line1r, anchor = north east, align = left, text ", f$p3_text_position[2], ", font = \\small] {", f$p3_txt[2], "};")`

  `r # Headings`
  \node[below right = 0.75cm and 0.2cm of line0l, anchor = south west, font = \Large\bf]{`r f$p3_heading[1]`};
  \node[below right = 0.75cm and 0.2cm of line1l, anchor = south west, font = \Large\bf]{`r if(nrow(f) == 2) f$p3_heading[2]`};

\end{tikzpicture}
